releases.name: Worm Wars: Snake Battle
releases.summary:
Worm Wars: Snake Battle is an exciting arcade game where you control a hungry worm, collect food, and battle other players to become the biggest worm in the arena!

Move around the arena, eat glowing food, collect cash, and grow longer with every bite. Outsmart rival worms, dodge their attacks, and make them crash into your body to collect their dropped rewards. Use your speed boost to escape danger, chase opponents, or gain the advantage in intense snake battles.

Customize your worm! Unlock a variety of fun skins inspired by animals, funny characters, memes, and more. Choose your favorite look and stand out from the crowd.

releases.name: We are Eva
releases.summary:
Are you reading this? Hi! My name is Eva. I'm the main protagonist of the game you're looking at. Yes, this little platformer game is about me... About me AND dimensional travel! Do you want to know more?

Okay, well... I am a (mostly) peaceful creature living between different worlds. Sleeping is usually all I do, but right now, something evil is happening to said worlds, and I want it to stop. That's where I need you, for your ability to see in 2D... There's no time to explain!!!

Play the game in multiple dimensions simultaneously, traveling through them at will!

Each level changes whenever you fail! Say "yes!" to an ever-fresh experience!

releases.name: Outbreak: Dead City
releases.summary: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

releases.name: Let's Sing 2027
releases.summary:
Grab the mic - or your smartphone - and get ready to shine! The karaoke game Let's Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable parties and performances.

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let's Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. 

Whether you're hosting a party or chasing your best score, it's your turn to take center stage with the ultimate karaoke game!

releases.name: MECCHA Hide And Seek
releases.summary:
Explore every corner and uncover the best-hidden chameleons.

Become a skilled hunter in MECCHA Hide And Seek, a fun hide-and-seek experience where sharp eyes, focus, and quick reactions are the keys to success. Search carefully through detailed environments and find tiny chameleons cleverly hidden throughout each location. With dozens of possible hiding spots and different chameleon sizes, every round challenges you to observe your surroundings and spot what others might miss.

Explore six levels across three distinct environments: offices, bathrooms, and parking areas. Each location offers a fresh search experience, with six chameleons randomly placed every time you enter the map. Choose from three difficulty levels, where the challenge increases as the chameleons become smaller and more difficult to find. Race against the clock, discover every hiding spot, and collect points as you sharpen your hunting skills.

Key Features:
• Six Unique Levels: Search through office, bathroom, and parking environments.
• Randomized Hiding Spots: Find chameleons in different locations every time you play.
• Three Difficulty Levels: Test your observation skills as the hidden targets become smaller and harder to spot.
• Time-Based Challenges: Search quickly, stay focused, and earn points before time runs out.

releases.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
releases.summary:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. 

Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

releases.name: Cat President 2: Purrlitical Revolution
releases.summary:
The cats are back to win your heart -- and your vote!

In a world where talking cats control the U.S. government, President DJ Nibbles is running for re-election -- and you've been hired to stop him at all costs. Who cares that you're a random ride-share driver who didn't even know an election was happening? That doesn't mean you can't run the purrfect campaign!

Can you handle the world of Presidential politics? Do you even know what a campaign manager does? Will you find love or heartbreak with your candidate? Leading the purrlitical revolution is up to you!

releases.name: Tarot Tokens
releases.summary:
Tarot Tokens is a strategic tile game inspired by the Fools journey through the major arcana of the tarot. Placing Tarot Tokens crafts your journey from four key aspects of the major arcana of the tarot: family, morals, conflict, hope.

The aim of Tarot Tokens is to build your three virtues up and keep them nicely balanced by making wise, or seemingly foolish choices, along the way. Run out of any virtue and the journey ends. Reach the end by taking all the steps and reflect on your journey - learn to see pass the numbers and embrace your whole journey.

releases.name: SUPER ARROW SHOT
releases.summary:
Can you defeat your enemies before they have time to react?

SUPER ARROW SHOT is a minimalist first-person archery action game where time moves only when you do. Enter a frozen world where enemies stand still, arrows hang in the air, and every movement can change the outcome of a battle. Study your surroundings, plan your next move, and strike before your enemies have a chance to react.

Take control of every encounter with precise archery and tactical movement. Find the perfect position, predict incoming attacks, use the environment to your advantage, and eliminate your targets one by one.

releases.name: Nyghtmare: The Ninth King
releases.summary:
The forgotten Kingdom of Mortemire has returned from the darkness. Whip, jump, and fight your way through a brutal dark-fantasy adventure!

Centuries after vanishing without a trace, the Kingdom of Mortemire suddenly reappears.

Alongside it awakens Aryn, a young woman strangely unaffected by the mysterious call surrounding the kingdom. Armed with only an iron whip, she ventures into its decaying streets in search of answers, facing the creatures and dangers that have taken hold of the land.

Nyghtmare: The Ninth King is a dark-fantasy retro "Vania" experience. Fight your way through carefully placed enemies, treacherous jumps, hidden routes, and deadly encounters as you explore Mortemire and meet the few souls still wandering its roads.

Choose between two playable characters, each with their own campaign and ending. Discover branching paths, face different final bosses, and master a moveset that combines classic action with faster modern touch.

A nostalgic experience that can also be played in vertical mode with touch controls to better match the '90s feeling!

releases.name: Neverway
releases.summary:
After Fiona quits her job, she starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. 

Keep your life from falling apart while searching for Neverway, a nightmare reality that is slowly leaking into yours.

Neverway features a top-down, fast-paced combat with an emphasis on player expression. Craft items to customize your playstyle, and unlock combat abilities through your friendship bonds.

Farm and craft items, prepare meals, or just decorate your homestead. Time progresses in three blocks, and you choose when to advance: morning, afternoon, and evening. One day at a time.

releases.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
releases.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

releases.name: Word Quest Horror
releases.summary:
Enter if you dare… the words are watching.

Step into the shadows with Word Quest: Horror, a chilling word search journey through haunted mansions, dark forests, and forgotten crypts. Connect letters to reveal hidden words lurking in the mist and solve eerie puzzles that grow more spine-tingling with every level. Strange whispers guide your path as you uncover secrets buried deep in the darkness. Can you keep your nerve and conquer every haunting challenge?

releases.name: Derby.io
releases.summary:
Smash Crash Survive Win

Smash, crash and battle your way to victory in fast-paced arcade action!

Take on rival cars in chaotic arenas where only one driver can survive. Slam into your opponents, deal damage and stay in the fight as cars become dented, start smoking and eventually catch fire. Take too much damage and it’s game over in an explosive finish!

Power-ups are scattered around each track to give you an edge. Grab a Speed Boost for a quick burst of acceleration or collect a Heart to restore damage and keep you in the battle.

The longer you survive, the more coins you earn. Use your rewards to unlock new cars and tracks, then jump straight back into the action and fight to be the last car standing!

releases.name: Innocent Memory
releases.summary:
The protagonist, Seiichi Makita, suddenly finds himself lost in an unknown world—a mysterious place free from all the injustices of ordinary life. Humans, animals, and plants alike are free to live as they wish in this seemingly ideal world.

Having lost most of his memories, Seiichi sets out in search of a way back to his own world alongside Yuki, a cat-eared girl he meets there. As their journey continues, fragments of his lost memories gradually begin to return. And beyond them lies a truth Seiichi could never have imagined...

releases.name: HorrorVale
releases.summary:
Welcome to HorrorVale! Your next door neighbors are zombies, reanimated monsters deliver the mail and ghosts hide out in your bathroom. Join Alice as she journeys through the underworld on a quest to save her zombie Dog, Scruffy from strange and unusual monsters that have suddenly invaded the once peaceful town of HorrorVale.

HorrorVale is a traditional RPG adventure game inspired by horror, full of unexpected twists and turns.

releases.name: Pinballoid Crush
releases.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

releases.name: Retro Video Store Simulator
releases.summary:
Build your retro store and bring classic nostalgia back to life.

Step into a stylish 90s-inspired city and take charge of your own retro store. In this first-person business simulator, buy nostalgic products, organize your shelves, serve customers, and transform a small shop into a successful local business filled with classic media and vintage technology.

Order new stock, unpack deliveries, arrange your products, and keep your customers happy. Use your profits to expand your selection, purchase new equipment, improve your store layout, and add decorative touches that capture the authentic atmosphere of the 90s. Every improvement brings more customers, more opportunities, and a bigger business.

Key Features:
• Run Your Retro Store: Manage daily operations, serve customers, and grow your business.
• Stock Classic Products: Sell VHS tapes, video players, cameras, vinyl records, magazines, comics, and retro electronics.
• Unpack & Organize: Receive deliveries, unpack your products, and arrange them throughout your store.
• Grow Your Business: Use your profits to unlock new products, equipment, shelves, and upgrades.
• Customize Your Store: Create a unique 90s atmosphere with neon signs, posters, vintage lamps, and retro decorations.

releases.name: Space Rock Breaker
releases.summary:
Space Rock Breaker is a short incremental experience.

Mine asteroids using weapons, process the ore using a Plinko machine, and use the rewards to increase your power.

releases.name: Turbo Hills
releases.summary: Turbo Hills is a fun and fast-paced hill racing game where players drive across bumpy tracks, collect coins, manage fuel, and try to go as far as possible without crashing. Upgrade your vehicle, master tricky terrain, and keep your momentum to beat your best distance. With colorful visuals, simple controls, and addictive gameplay, Turbo Hills delivers an exciting off-road adventure for players of all ages.

releases.name: Goodboy Galaxy
releases.summary:
With his home world on the brink of ecological collapse, Maxwell bravely hopped into his experimental ship in dogged pursuit of a solution.

Beyond the point of no return, holding out forlorn hope, he finds himself stranded - thousands of lightyears from home, at the edge of a hostile galaxy.

Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.

Goodboy Galaxy is a game in development for Game Boy Advance, PC and Nintendo Switch. It's an exploration focused platform game similar to Metroid or Cave Story.

releases.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
releases.summary: The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

releases.name: Yandere Hotline
releases.summary:
Your phone buzzes at midnight, and you already know who it is.
After the worst breakup of your life, a friend talks you into trying HOTLINE — a companionship service where lonely people call in just to hear a voice that cares. One conversation. That's all it's supposed to be.
Then she starts calling you.
Not the operator. Her. The girl on the other end who remembers everything you say, who's always awake when you need her, who somehow always knows exactly where you are.
Talk to her. Fall for her. Try to walk away — see how that goes.
That's when you start noticing things about HOTLINE itself. The company that swore this was just business. The calls that came before you ever dialed a number.

* Erika never hangs up first. She'll listen to everything — and never quite let go.
* Kai's always available, always charming... right up until you realize how much he already knows.
* Mia never raises her voice. That's exactly why she's the one you should worry about.

Features:
♥ TELEPHONE ROMANCE: Every call is a choice. Say the right thing — or find out what happens when you don't.
♥ VISUAL NOVEL STORYTELLING: Branching conversations, hidden memories, and secrets that unravel one call at a time.
♥ FIVE DISTINCT VOICES: Ren, Erika, Kai, Elena, Mia — five people, five obsessions, none of them innocent.
♥ A COMPANY WITH SECRETS: HOTLINE isn't just connecting calls. Find out what it's really doing with yours.

releases.name: Ouija
releases.summary:
A birthday night. An abandoned house. A question they should never have asked.

Vera and her friends enter the Arce house to celebrate Carla's birthday with a second-hand Ouija board. Amid jokes and candlelight, someone answers from the board: Elisa, a girl who lived there in 1987. When the front door closes on its own, the party becomes a desperate search for answers.

The board exposes secrets the group hoped to keep buried. Carla disappears and returns speaking as though she belongs to another time, while Leo knows more about the house than he admits. Vera must decide whom to trust as she uncovers what happened to Elisa and how to end a session that refuses to close.

In Ouija, your choices guide Vera through 12 chapters of supernatural horror, puzzles and strained relationships. Each decision can bring her closer to the truth, change her friends' fates or leave someone trapped inside the house.

releases.name: Soft Coven
releases.summary:
Some places seem to find you just when you need to disappear the most.

Lina arrives in a small town shrouded in mist, determined to leave her old life behind. There, she begins working alongside Nora and Mar in a mysterious esoteric shop filled with strange objects, forgotten secrets and signs that magic may be far more real than it seems.

What begins as a fresh start soon becomes something far more dangerous. Buried secrets, unexpected feelings and impossible events begin to bind their lives together. Every decision can bring them closer, tear them apart or uncover a truth that should perhaps have remained hidden.

In Soft Coven, you decide who to trust, which secrets to pursue and how far you are willing to go to uncover the truth. Your choices will reshape relationships, open new paths and determine which of many possible destinies becomes real.

Features
• Discover more than 40 alternate endings
• Choose your own path and change the fate of the story
• Solve more than 10 puzzles woven into the narrative
• Unlock all 24 achievements to reveal every secret
• Meet a cast of characters filled with mysteries, bonds and contradictions
• Explore distinctive locations shaped by magic, romance and danger
• Make decisions capable of transforming every relationship
• Play again to uncover hidden scenes, routes and revelations

releases.name: Four Bloods Academy
releases.summary:
Nobody wanted the human scholarship. You took it anyway.

At an elite academy ruled by the Four Supernatural Families — vampire, demon, beast, and sorcerer bloodlines — a human student isn't supposed to speak first, let alone speak back.

Then you do exactly that. In front of everyone. To the vampire heir who's never been told no in his life.

He doesn't forget it. He can't seem to.

Now Kael won't stop watching you, chasing an obsession he doesn't fully understand himself. And while he circles closer, Rowan — heir to the Beast clan — keeps finding reasons to stand between you and every threat the Academy throws your way, warmth wrapped around wounds he never talks about.

Somewhere between the four bloodlines, the politics, and the secrets the Families are keeping from each other, you'll discover your scholarship was never random at all.

- Kael won't say what he wants from you. He'll just make sure you can't walk away from him either.
- Rowan never asks for anything back. That's exactly what makes it so easy to fall for him.
- Damion smiles like he already knows how this ends — for you, and for everyone else in the room.
- Aiden reads people like open books. Yours is the only one he can't finish.

releases.name: Five Nights at Pizzeria 2
releases.summary:
Clock In. Check the Cameras. Survive Until 7 AM.

Survive the graveyard shift in this intense first-person 3D survival horror game! As the night security guard at a retro family pizzeria, can you outsmart killer animatronics and make it alive until 7 AM?

Trapped inside your security office, you are alone in the dark. Switch between live camera feeds to track wandering animatronics across dining rooms and party halls. When they get too close, check your hallway door lights and slam down the heavy blast doors to block their attack.

But watch your power meter! Every camera check, light switch, and closed door rapidly drains your strictly limited battery supply. If the power runs out, the lights die and you are left completely defenseless in the dark. Do you have the nerves to survive five terrifying nights?

Key Features:
• First-Person 3D Survival Horror: Experience tense, claustrophobic office gameplay filled with terrifying animatronics, atmospheric audio, and heart-pounding jump scares.
• Live Camera Surveillance: Monitor multiple security feeds across the pizzeria to track approaching monsters and delay their movements before they reach your office.

releases.name: Distorted - Paranormal Activities
releases.summary:
A psychological horror game as paranormal investigator.

People leave traces when they go. Some leave more than that.
In Distorted – Paranormal Activities, you are commissioned to investigate an old apartment building that was quietly evacuated after a series of incidents no official report has satisfactorily explained. Your assignment is straightforward: visit each day, walk the floors, check the units, and determine whether what is happening inside is genuinely supernatural.
The building receives you with the particular stillness of a place that used to be full of life. Doormats still outside flats. A child's drawing taped to a hallway wall. Furniture left exactly as it stood on the last morning people were here.
But something lingers. A door left open that was closed. A name scratched into a wall that doesn't match any resident record. A figure standing at the far end of a corridor that isn't there when you reach it.
Each day follows the same procedure: Move through the building, observe what has changed, and trust what you remember. If something unnatural has occurred, you must place a cleansing marker in the building's old boiler room before leaving. If the day seems undisturbed, you return home and come back tomorrow.
But your judgment matters. Leave a marker on a quiet day, or leave without one when something was truly there — and the investigation starts to collapse.

releases.name: Horror Love
releases.summary:
How far would you go for a love that should never have started?

Nora arrives in Ravenhollow just days before Halloween, to settle into the old house she's just inherited. The town is getting ready for the Harvest Vigil, a celebration full of pumpkins, lanterns, and traditions no one seems willing to fully explain.

There, she meets Damian.

The pull between them is immediate. There's just one problem: he's engaged to Selene.

As Nora and Damian grow closer, stranger things start happening. A candle that goes out with no breeze. A figure that appears in reflections. Memories that don't feel like her own. And an old legend about a creature that feeds on forbidden desire.

Is it guilt that's haunting Nora… or has her love woken something that's been waiting for generations?

Features
• Live a psychological horror romance thriller.
• Uncover an story of desire, guilt, and obsession.
• Explore 12 chapters set in a town trapped in an eternal autumn.
• Make choices that lead to different endings.
• Solve sliding puzzles to reveal hidden scenes.
• Uncover Ravenhollow's past and the legend of the Harvester.
• Unlock 24 illustrated achievements.
• Enjoy cinematic scenes crafted for the story's biggest moments.

releases.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
releases.summary: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It is fun to have fun, but you have to know how.” Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 and Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride. Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then “Find the Cat” will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from. But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone. Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

releases.name: Look Outside
releases.summary:
Some terrible phenomenon is taking place outside.
Those who look are changed in grotesque ways.
Something beckons you to look, too.
DO IT.

Explore the warped interior of the apartment building you are stuck in. Fight hideous monsters that were once your neighbors. Manage weapons and ammo. Play video games. Craft bombs from household supplies. Cook. Answer the door. DONT let them in.
Keep yourself alive and sane as the world just outside your window stops making sense.

Just whatever you do...
(DONT) LOOK OUTSIDE

releases.name: Asylum
releases.summary:
ASYLUM is an ambitious and intricate first-person horror adventure casting you into the hallucinatory setting of the Hanwell Mental Institute. Interact with its curious denizens, gather clues, unravel the mystery, and march towards a shocking conclusion.

With influences ranging from Lovecraft to Peter Cushing to Lucio Fulci, ASYLUM has been meticulously crafted with a strong focus on storytelling and atmosphere. Explore countless tenebrous environments, make your way through a towering, lifelike mental hospital, and solve compelling puzzles to find the answers you seek.

releases.name: The Night of the Exorcism
releases.summary:
Summoned to the remote village of Southshire-Upon-Yail, you must diagnose the afflictions of a young woman that suffers a mysterious illness. Each decision you make will unveil a piece of the mystery and bring you closer to discovering the truth behind her ailments, and whatever harms her.

Will you be able to save Isabella before she is taken by her tormentors?

releases.name: Blasphemous: Martyrs' Edition
releases.summary: The Martyr’s Limited Edition includes the complete Blasphemous game with all expansions, along with a visual compendium featuring iconic artwork, a printed manual, an exclusive art print, a personal letter from the development team, and a digital code to download the full soundtrack.

releases.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
releases.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

releases.name: UNDERGROUNDED
releases.summary: UNDERGROUNDED is a puzzle adventure game that takes you through nostalgic landscapes of America's past. Help a young man travel through an underground maze looking for a lost ring, using the mysterious power of... retro games.

releases.name: Pardon My French Toast
releases.summary:
Welcome to the Jam Session Cruise! Lucky you, you just happened to stumble across a ticket for a lovely vacation at sea! At least, until you discover that this boat can barely float!

Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

Explore dozens of levels and find huge candies to fuel the boat. From fruity cakes to tropical jungles to haunted floating islands (and more!), get bready for some tasty sights!

You're not alone on this cruise; lots of other toasts are along for the ride! Get to know them: they’ve all got a good reason for being there. Maybe you can help them?

releases.name: Zombie Outbreak: Last Stand Survival
releases.summary:
Complete the mission. Protect the cure. Survive the outbreak.

A deadly outbreak has turned the city into a territory of the infected. Follow the trail of Dr. Varga and Project Lazarus — humanity's last chance to stop the infection.

Fight through a full mission-based zombie survival campaign spanning 15 chapters and 29 missions. Explore ruined hospitals, contaminated sewers, abandoned farms, industrial zones, railways, underground stations and devastated city streets while uncovering the truth behind the outbreak.

releases.name: MeowPower! Yachiyo
releases.summary:
Join forces with feline friends to take down heinous humans in this fur-raising, tail-shaking, belt-scrolling action game!

Unleash your inner wild cat and claw your way to victory! Play as heroine Yachiyo and bring down baddies alongside paw-some pals!

Explore:
Venture your way through all sorts of areas—forests, mountains, and even...a FORTRESS?!

Grow:
Power up and learn new skills!

Collect:
Clobber enemies to collect junk—er, treasure!

Bonus:
Wait, there's a bonus game, too?!

releases.name: Olivia
releases.summary: Once a family home, now stands silent. The past still whispers through every room. You are looking for inspiration for a film, but you will find much more than just a story. Whether the lights are on or off... it doesn't matter. Olivia will find you.

releases.name: Puzzle X: Premium Girls
releases.summary:
Every piece brings you closer to perfection!

Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.

releases.name: Warfighter
releases.summary:
Countdown in the Dark: Breach the Veiled Final Line of Defense

"In the fleeting moment before a cataclysmic clash, a covert operation unfolds to neutralize an unseen threat."

On the front lines of the Arcadia Peninsula, a deeply concealed truth lies hidden. Seizing the chaos, the military cartel 'Black Vapor' and rebel forces are racing to complete 'Ares,' a weapon capable of shaking the world. A communication glitch and a vanished reconnaissance aircraft exposed this hidden stronghold, prompting Headquarters to act before a full crisis hits.

A heart-pounding infiltration by an elite special forces unit under strict secrecy. A new chapter of Warfighter, featuring hyper-realistic visuals and high-tension tactical gameplay, begins now.


・Visually Stunning Realism and Extreme Performance
From scorching sandstorms to the stealth of night combat, every detail comes alive. Choose your mode: 'Quality Mode' for cinematic immersion or 'Performance Mode' for smooth, responsive split-second combat.

releases.name: Bella Umbrella and the mysterious garden
releases.summary:
Follow the scent, trust the wind and discover what secret awaits Bella and Neko in the heart of the garden.

Join Bella and her cat Neko on an enchanting journey through a mysterious Japanese garden full of puzzles, hidden paths and unexpected discoveries.

When Neko slips through a small opening into the garden, Bella follows him without meaning to – a sudden gust of wind catches her umbrella and carries it over the high walls. What at first seems like an ordinary garden soon turns out to be full of secrets.

Explore 300 meticulously designed levels across 30 unique regions, which together create an atmospheric journey through the garden. Discover blossoming cherry trees, tranquil ponds, winding stone paths, ancient pagodas, peaceful temples and much more. With each new region, the garden reveals new facets of its beauty. Yet at the same time, you get the impression that there is something even greater concealed behind it all.

Two characters, two different puzzles in each level

Start by playing as Neko and find your way to his beloved fish. Use his special jumps, plan each move carefully and reach the finish in a set number of moves. Explore carefully – you might even discover some hidden secrets along the way.

You will then take control of Bella. With the help of her umbrella, she lets the wind carry her through the garden. Making clever use of the wind strength and direction, fly from flower to flower and find your way to your destination. Each challenge requires logical thinking and careful planning.

On your journey, you can find and collect lots of hidden puzzle pieces. The more you discover, the more special content you’ll unlock. For curious explorers, every peek into the garden’s hidden corners is well worth it.

Enjoy the whole adventure together

In the local two-player multiplayer mode, you can either control your favourite character throughout, or swap roles after each level. Additional stats at the end of each level encourage friendly competition and invite players to compare their best solutions.

Features
• Explore a beautiful Japanese garden full of puzzles and secrets.
• Journey through 30 atmospheric regions that tell a complete story.
• Solve 300 handcrafted puzzle challenges.
• Play as the curious cat Neko and the brave Bella, who move through the garden in completely different ways.
• Keep an eye out for hidden puzzle pieces and reveal additional secrets.
• Unlock special rewards through skilful exploring.
• Play on your own or experience the whole adventure together in local multiplayer mode.
• Perfect for players of all ages: easy to learn and full of clever challenges.

releases.name: Number Logic
releases.summary:
Challenge your mind with a classic number-placement puzzle based on Sudoku.

Put your logic skills to the test in a classic number-placement puzzle experience based on Sudoku. Fill each grid by carefully placing numbers so that every row, column, and section follows the familiar rules of the genre.

Choose a difficulty level that matches your mood, whether you want a relaxing puzzle session or a more demanding challenge. Use logical deduction to work through each board, make notes when you are unsure, and gradually eliminate possibilities until the entire grid is complete.

Helpful tools make it easy to focus on solving. Add pencil notes, use hints when you get stuck, and spot mistakes more easily with clear visual feedback. With dynamically generated puzzles, there is always another grid waiting to be solved.

Take your time, think ahead, and enjoy a clean and focused puzzle experience designed for both newcomers and experienced number-puzzle fans.

Features:

Classic number-placement gameplay based on Sudoku.
Multiple difficulty levels for casual and experienced players.
Dynamically generated puzzles for continued replayability.
Pencil notes to help track possible numbers.
Hint system for difficult situations.

releases.name: Hot Spring Beauties Japanese Inn Date Memory
releases.summary:
Memorize the perfect ryokan moment! A quick photo memory challenge How many details can you remember?

Take a good look at photos set in a relaxing Japanese hot spring inn and try to remember every detail before time runs out!

From open-air baths and cozy guest rooms to elegant lounges and peaceful gardens, each scene is packed with details worth remembering.

How to play:
・Study the photo before time runs out
・Remember the people, poses, clothing, and objects around them
・Use your memory to take on the challenge

The simple gameplay makes it easy to jump in for a quick session. Enjoy the photos at your own pace while putting your memory and observation skills to the test.

Recommended for players who:
・Enjoy photo and memory games
・Like testing their observation skills
・Love Japanese inns and hot spring scenery
・Want something easy to play in short sessions
・Enjoy relaxing, glamorous photography

How much of each scene can you remember?

releases.name: Souls of Bombarika
releases.summary: A lone ghost battles deadly Ghost Bosses threatening humanity. Possess objects, solve reality-bending puzzles, and uncover an emotional mother-son story.

releases.name: Mystery Room - Crime Scene Tap Detective -
releases.summary:
A crime scene can hide the smallest detail. Do you have what it takes to notice what feels out of place?

Take a close look at illustrated crime scenes and tap suspicious locations to uncover clues. This casual mystery game challenges your observation and deduction skills as you work toward the truth.

Getting started is easy!
• Read the situation and question
• Examine the scene illustration carefully
• Tap the location that seems suspicious

Where is the clue that connects everything? Ordinary objects, unusual behavior, and subtle details may all hold the key to solving the case.

You only need to choose the spot that catches your attention, so anyone can enjoy the challenge—even if you do not usually play detective games.

Think through each scene on your own, or compare theories with family and friends. The quick-to-play format is perfect for a short break whenever you want to test your powers of observation and deduction.

Can you uncover the decisive clue hidden at the scene? Solve every mystery and get closer to the truth!

releases.name: TOKYO WANTED
releases.summary: Three fugitives —the VECTOR —hide among a hundred pedestrians. Three hunters —the ONI —get one wanted poster, with two traits on it and nothing more. Plenty of people match it. Blend in, swap your appearance, and break for the goal. At halftime, the teams switch sides.

releases.name: Death Room: A Psychological Horror Killing Game
releases.summary:
Four girls. One locked room. Only one will survive. Will it be you?

You wake up locked in a single room with three other girls, complete strangers, forced to play a killing game none of you agreed to.

Search every corner, solve twisted puzzles, and win every macabre challenge you come across, because in this game, only one of you walks out alive.

Every girl beside you is hiding something, and figuring out who you can trust matters just as much as any puzzle.

Are you good enough to be the one who survives?


FEATURES:

● A ROOM FULL OF TWISTED PUZZLES: Every corner hides a new macabre challenge you must beat to survive.

● SHE'S ALWAYS WATCHING: The woman behind this killing game controls every rule, and she's never far.

● FOUR GIRLS, FOUR SECRETS: Tense conversations between challenges reveal who you can trust, and who's lying.

● EVERY CHALLENGE COUNTS: Losing isn't an option. Every challenge you beat keeps you in the game.
